source.relevant_validation: sessionPrefix and task.id both independently allow '-'

impact: Two logically different subagent identities can address the same explicit Qwen/OpenCode session key.
Because that key is sent as x-opencode-session-id, a collision can share durable checkpoint/thread/account affinity between unrelated child tasks.
This is especially relevant to the future Notion-to-Qwen adapter, which requires deterministic restart-safe child identities.

candidate_contract.rule: Derive the complete provider session id from an unambiguous canonical tuple, rather than concatenating independently valid fields with an allowed delimiter.
requirements: different tuples that collide under raw '-' concatenation -> different session ids
no provider account id, remote thread id, prompt text, or secret in the identity
